summary: On the night of a major address, people leave public places to get home to a set in time.
realLife: A civics narrative says that before a December 1940 chat, people left movies and restaurants to be home by nine to listen.
gates: A national address is aired in the evening.
inGame: The President's address watched at home and the town emptying early could carry it.

turns.what: Nobody tunes in and the street is busy.
Some watch and some do not.
Only the older members of the house listen.
